scope: All 63 numbered result rows from the surviving PropertyAuctions AID 482 grid for the 26 February 2007 Savills Commercial sale. The archived first-party Savills page identifies the date, states a total of 63 lots across four catalogue pages and exposes lots 1-20 on page 1. Those first 20 rows reconcile to the secondary grid. The secondary grid exposes lots 1-63 exactly once and reports Offered: 63. Residential lots 60-61 are retained. Street addresses and postcodes are not exposed and remain null.
completion_scope: all numbered lots 1-63 appear exactly once in the result grid and reconcile to both the first-party total of 63 and the secondary Offered: 63 denominator
